listings.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
listings.description: Smoking is the focus of this cooking series hosted by award-winning author, journalist and cooking teacher Steven Raichlen. Presented by Maryland Public Television, the series offers how-to's for smoking just about anything, from barbecued pork and lamb shoulders to a smokehouse ham from scratch and whole king salmon. Viewers learn how to use different devices such as drum smokers, electric smokers, charcoal grills and handheld smokers. Shot on location at J.W. Marriott Starr Pass Resort in Tucson, episodes feature other interesting items including bacon, jerky, prime rib and even eggplant and cheesecake.
listings.episode_description: Rotisserie-smoked chicken with drop pan root vegetables; bourbon brown sugar-smoked pork loin; brisket on the bone; smoke-roasted pears.

listings.title: J Schwanke's Life in Bloom
listings.description: Fourth-generation florist, author and floral educator J Schwanke hosts this series about flower arrangement, design and instruction. Aiming to help viewers have fun with flowers, the program shows how to incorporate flowers into homes and everyday life. The series also includes tours of flower farms, greenhouses, markets, festivals and special events around the world. Some segments include a visit to a succulent farm, tulip-inspired recipes, using fruit and flowers in arrangements, recipes and crafts and creating an orchid wreath.
listings.episode_description: A nature center with animal ambassadors; raising and releasing monarch butterflies.

listings.title: Rick Steves' Europe
listings.description: Rick Steves' guidebooks, public-radio program and numerous television series have made him an essential resource for travelers wishing to explore Europe. This program finds the knowledgeable host offering globetrotters a fresh perspective on lodgings, transportation and places to visit on their journeys. One thing that hasn't changed, however, is Steves' belief that travelers should become "temporary locals," exploring not only major cities and the usual sites, but out-of-the-way locales that often produce the most authentic, and enjoyable, experiences of a trip.
listings.episode_description: Three historic capitals of Iran are Persepolis, Shiraz and Esfahan.

listings.title: The Best of the Joy of Painting
listings.description: This series of episodes culled from the vast library of the late Bob Ross ("The Joy of Painting") features the soft-spoken host sharing his painting techniques, including his "wet-on-wet" technique, and creating some of his best-loved scenes. From a cabin in the majestic mountains or a covered bride to an owl in a country barn or an autumnal forest scene, Ross creates a complete work of art in each episode -- many of which feature his trademark "happy little clouds." His soothing tone and words of encouragement inspire those painting along at home, and entrance those just watching to see him create his nature scenes.
listings.episode_description: Water splashes down at the old mill.

Episodes focus on the rules of making patterns and how they apply to preparing a garment for stitching. Projects range from ones that require just a single stitch to more elaborate items such as pants, sleeves, tank tops and wrap dresses. Other segments include how to make a cape, use zippers and sew a half-circle skirt.
listings.episode_description: The importance of line, focal point, color and proportion, as they relate to the body.

listings.description: Hosts Bridget Lancaster and Julia Collin Davison offer a practical, no-nonsense and scientific approach to making a wide range of American recipes, from barbecue chicken thighs to Mississippi mud pie to parmesan potatoes. The hosts are joined by test cooks Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof, Christie Morrison, Lawman Johnson, and Natalie Estrada. Episodes include equipment recommendations for the home cook, taste tests and origins for new recipes such as Southern-style smothered chicken, grilled bourbon steaks and many more.
listings.episode_description: Seattle chicken teriyaki; sweet potato salad with cumin, smoked paprika and almonds; Chef Nobu; miso black cod.

listings.title: America's Test Kitchen From Cook's Illustrated
listings.description: Bridget Lancaster and Julia Collin Davison host a look inside America's Test Kitchen, which features a team of experts who check out the latest in cooking utensils, ingredients and cooking techniques. listings.description: This show follows the adventures of animated versions of brothers Chris and Martin Kratt, hosts of such educational shows as "Kratts' Creatures" and "Zoboomafoo." In the show, the animated Kratts encounter wild animals during stories of adventure and mystery. The live-action Kratt brothers introduce each episode.
listings.episode_description: Martin takes the Wild Kratts team on a mission to discover more about a hawk he's seen in the Sonoran Desert.

listings.title: Alma's Way
listings.episode_title: Lost in the Bronx; New Neighbors
listings.description: Six-year old Alma, a Puerto Rican girl who lives with her family in the Bronx, learns to think for herself, making mistakes and finding solutions along the way.
listings.episode_description: Alma and Uncle Nestor get separated from the rest of the family on the subway; Alma and Junior are excited about their new neighbors.

listings.title: Lyla in the Loop
listings.episode_title: Loopstastic Mess Vacuum Test; How the Cookie Crumbled
listings.description: Seven-year-old Lyla and her close-knit family address everyday problems together in the big city.
listings.episode_description: Luke, Lyla and Everett test vacuums; Lyla makes cookies using substituted ingredients.

listings.title: Wild Kratts
listings.description: This show follows the adventures of animated versions of brothers Chris and Martin Kratt, hosts of such educational shows as "Kratts' Creatures" and "Zoboomafoo." In the show, the animated Kratts encounter wild animals during stories of adventure and mystery. The live-action Kratt brothers introduce each episode.
listings.episode_description: Chris and Martin protect gila monsters from becoming part of Zach's invention.

listings.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
listings.episode_title: Time for Daniel; There's Time for Daniel and Baby Too
listings.description: The first series inspired by "Mister Rogers Neighborhood," "Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood" features 4-year-old Daniel Tiger, son of the original program's Daniel Striped Tiger. Every day Daniel puts on his red sweater, ties his shoes, and invites a new generation of preschoolers into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe. Daniel shares his daily adventures with pals O the Owl, Katerina Kittycat, Prince Wednesday and Miss Elaina. With the help of Daniel and his friends, preschoolers have fun and learn practical skills necessary for growing and developing.
listings.episode_description: Daniel gets upset when Dad interrupts their playtime so he can care for baby Margaret; Daniel is upset when Prince Wednesday wants to play with the baby instead of him.

listings.title: Rosie's Rules
listings.episode_title: The Catrina Mystery; The Lucky Dragon Dance
listings.description: Five-year-old Mexican American Rosie Fuentes learns how the world around her works in her suburban Texas community.
listings.episode_description: For the Day of the Dead celebration, Rosie is in charge of the Catrina doll, but it keeps disappearing; Rosie celebrates Lunar New Year with the Lius.

listings.title: Sesame Street
listings.description: A longtime favorite of children and adults, and a staple of PBS, "Sesame Street" bridges many cultural and educational gaps with a fun program. Big Bird leads a cast of characters teaching children numbers, colors and the alphabet. Bert and Ernie, Oscar the Grouch and Grover are just a few of the other creatures involved in this show, set on a city street full of valuable learning opportunities.
listings.episode_description: After a water leak in their apartment, Charlie and her family prepare their special Shabbat dinner in the arbor with their friends Elmo, Alan, Big Bird and Tamir; they learn how to make challah bread and set a traditional Shabbat table.

listings.title: Work It Out Wombats!
listings.description: A playful trio of marsupial siblings look for interesting problems to solve in their Treeborhood.
listings.episode_description: Super hunts for a lost sticker while the Wombats collaborate on a new ending for an old Sticker Monster story; the Wombats teach Zeke how to count to 10.

listings.title: Donkey Hodie
listings.description: Donkey Hodie and her pals follow their dreams and work together to find creative solutions to everyday problems.
listings.episode_description: Duck Duck's magic trick goes awry, turning her neighbors' things into pickles; Donkey is afraid to scooter after a fall.

listings.title: Pinkalicious & Peterrific
listings.description: The creative adventures of Pinkalicious and her brother, Peter.
listings.episode_description: Pinkalicious and Peter act like gnomes to guard the garden so Norman can sleep; Rafael's dog Rusty digs up a pink bone at the beach.

listings.title: Elinor Wonders Why
listings.description: The adventures of an observant and curious bunny rabbit named Elinor and her friends Ari the bat and Olive the elephant.
listings.episode_description: Crickets inspire Olive to play her violin; while flying in a hot air balloon, Elinor and her friends learn why birds fly high.

listings.title: Nature Cat
listings.description: This animated series centers on house cat Fred, a dreamer of the great outdoors. Once his family leaves for the day, Fred becomes Nature Cat and with the help of his animal friends, he embarks on action-packed adventures that allow him to explore the natural world. The series is voiced by comic actors, including "Saturday Night Live" alums Taran Killam (Nature Cat), Kate McKinnon (Squeeks), Bobby Moynihan (Hal) and Kenan Thompson (Ronald). Kate Micucci rounds out the cast as Daisy.
listings.episode_description: Daisy finds a glistening orange nugget on the beach, and Squeeks thinks it could be a piece of amber; a stinky smell may cause a problem for Nature Cat's family reunion.

listings.title: Molly of Denali
listings.episode_title: A Little Batty; The Clean Up Mix Up
listings.description: The daily adventures of 10-year-old Alaska native Molly Mabray, her family, her dog Suki and her friends Tooey and Trini.
listings.episode_description: Molly thinks she has seen a rare Australian megabat; Travis helps Molly, Tooey and Trini earn their wilderness cleanup badge.

listings.title: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
listings.episode_title: I Am Julia Child; I Am Neil Armstrong
listings.description: Xavier Riddle, his sister, Yadina, and their friend, Brad, meet heroes from the past -- from Eleanor Roosevelt to Leonardo da Vinci.
listings.episode_description: Watching Julia Child follow a step-by-step recipe encourages Xavier to do the same to build a model airplane; Neil Armstrong inspires Yadina to try new things.

listings.title: Antiques Roadshow
listings.description: Collectors discover that they can turn trash into treasure, thanks to the appraisal skills of the show's specialists in antiques and fine art.
listings.episode_description: Whitey Ford and Yogi Berra baseball jerseys, from 1955 and 1951, respectively; an 1863 gilt bronze-mounted gaslight; an 1887 Seth Whipple oil painting.

listings.title: Antiques Roadshow
listings.description: Collectors discover that they can turn trash into treasure, thanks to the appraisal skills of the show's specialists in antiques and fine art.
listings.episode_description: An Indian Tribes of North America set; a Gale Sayers game-worn jersey; Chinese glass bottle vases circa 1775.

listings.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
listings.description: The celebrity version of "Antiques Road Trip" sees two antique experts paired up with celebrity guests as they scour for antiques on a road trip around the country. Each episode features different expert and celebrity pairs who search for valuable items at bargain-basement prices. Once they have found their items, they then head to auction where the collectibles are put up for bid, with any profits made at auction donated to charity.
listings.episode_description: "The Bill" stars Roberta Taylor and Trudie Goodwin set off from Glasgow and charge around Stirlingshire, concluding with an auction in Harrogate; they are accompanied by experts Paul Laidlaw and James Braxton in two very nice classic cars.

listings.title: Singing Our Way to Freedom
listings.description: The life and music of Ramon "Chunky" Sanchez, including his transformation from a marginalized farm kid to social activist.

listings.title: PBS News Hour
listings.description: Co-anchors Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett and correspondents offer in-depth analysis of current events.
listings.episode_description: Co-anchors Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett and correspondents offer in-depth analysis of current events.

listings.title: BBC News America
listings.description: Live news program produced out of BBC's Washington, D.C. bureau; host Sumi Somaskanda.

listings.title: Rick Steves' Europe
listings.description: Rick Steves' guidebooks, public-radio program and numerous television series have made him an essential resource for travelers wishing to explore Europe. This program finds the knowledgeable host offering globetrotters a fresh perspective on lodgings, transportation and places to visit on their journeys. One thing that hasn't changed, however, is Steves' belief that travelers should become "temporary locals," exploring not only major cities and the usual sites, but out-of-the-way locales that often produce the most authentic, and enjoyable, experiences of a trip.
listings.episode_description: Jerusalem; harvesting olives near Ramallah; pilgrimage to Bethlehem; Abraham's tomb in Hebron.

listings.title: Big Cats 24/7
listings.description: Wildlife filmmakers follow the Okavango Delta's big cats.
listings.episode_description: A flood brings new challenges for the big cats; for the first time, the lion cubs experience water and the danger it brings.

listings.title: NOVA
listings.description: This long-running, award-winning documentary series focuses on science, its many applications, speculation, history and researchers. Inspired by the BBC documentary program "Horizons, " the U.S. series frequently features interviews with scientists directly involved in the topic at hand, and sometimes even boasts footage of a particular discovery.
listings.episode_description: Forces that create extreme weather conditions found on planets and moons.

listings.title: Secrets of the Dead
listings.description: Experts use modern forensic techniques to shed new light on historical mysteries such as the sinking of the Andrea Doria and the riddle of whether a weather or geological event of some kind might have triggered the Dark Ages.
listings.episode_description: A team of archaeologists search for Assyrian artifacts that survived the Isis occupation of Mosul, including clues to a possible location of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.

listings.title: Amanpour and Company
listings.description: Christiane Amanpour leads discussions about world issues and interviews with global leaders.
listings.episode_description: Christiane Amanpour leads discussions about world issues and interviews with global leaders.
